accepted.s: The Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST) is located at:
accepted.x: IIST is located at Thiruvananthapuram. It is a deemed university under the Department of Space and was set up in 2007.
accepted.tq: Use direct location-based recall and distinguish IIST from other space institutions.
accepted.sec: IIRS and training bodies - former name, year, location, disciplines  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology is correct?
o: It was established in 1966 as a constituent unit of ISRO.
It is affiliated to the United Nations and hosted at Dehradun.
It was set up in 2007 as a deemed university under the Department of Space.
It is the virtual space museum of ISRO.
accepted.x: IIST was established in 2007 as a deemed university under the Department of Space. The other descriptions refer to IIRS, CSSTEAP and SPARK respectively.
accepted.tq: Match the institution with its correct establishment and administrative status.
accepted.sec: IIRS and training bodies - former name, year, location, disciplines  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Centre for Space Science and Technology Education in Asia and the Pacific (CSSTEAP):
1. It is affiliated to the United Nations.
2. It was set up in 1995.
3. It is hosted at IIRS, Dehradun.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: CSSTEAP is affiliated to the United Nations, was established in 1995 and is hosted at IIRS, Dehradun.
accepted.tq: Combine three closely related institutional attributes and test the all-correct option.
accepted.sec: IIRS and training bodies - former name, year, location, disciplines  [APPSC]

accepted.s: SPARK, launched by ISRO on 10 August 2022, is best described as:

accepted.s:
With reference to YUVIKA, consider the following statements:
1. Its full form is Yuva Vigyani Karyakram.
2. It is intended for school students.
3. It was launched in 2019.
4. Its second batch was held in 2022.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: YUVIKA means Yuva Vigyani Karyakram, is a school-student programme launched in 2019, and its second batch was held in 2022.
accepted.tq: Check a programme through its expansion, target group, launch year and batch chronology.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the principal focus of Space Technology Incubation Centres (STICs)?
o: Regulating all private space companies through a single window
Tracking launch vehicles during ascent from foreign stations
Promoting universities in tier-2 and tier-3 cities
accepted.x: The six STICs promote space-technology activities in universities, particularly those in tier-2 and tier-3 cities.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about ISTRAC is correct?
o: It is headquartered at Ahmedabad and regulates private space activity.
It is headquartered at Bengaluru and runs the telemetry, tracking and command network.
It is headquartered at Thiruvananthapuram and operates only communication satellites.
It is located at Dehradun and conducts professional training in GIS.
accepted.x: ISTRAC is headquartered at Bengaluru and operates the telemetry, tracking and command network used to track launch vehicles during ascent.
accepted.tq: Use the ‘who performs this function?’ method to identify the correct organisation.
accepted.sec: ISRO ground network - ISTRAC stations abroad, tracking MoUs  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
ISTRAC stations abroad include:
1. Mauritius
2. Brunei
3. Biak in Indonesia
4. Byalalu near Bengaluru
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Mauritius, Brunei and Biak in Indonesia are overseas ISTRAC stations. Byalalu near Bengaluru is the location of the Indian Deep Space Network, not an overseas station.
accepted.tq: Separate overseas stations from a domestic deep-space network location.
accepted.sec: ISRO ground network - ISTRAC stations abroad, tracking MoUs  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Indian Deep Space Network is located at:
accepted.x: The Indian Deep Space Network is located at Byalalu near Bengaluru.
accepted.tq: Apply the location distinction between launch, training and deep-space facilities.
accepted.sec: ISRO ground network - ISTRAC stations abroad, tracking MoUs  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following institutional developments in chronological order:
A. Establishment of ISRO
B. Formation of INCOSPAR
C. Creation of the Space Commission and Department of Space
D. Establishment of SpIN

Select the correct answer.
accepted.x: INCOSPAR was formed in 1962, ISRO was established in 1969, the Space Commission and DoS were created in 1972, and SpIN was launched in 2022.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest events first, then place the 1969 and 1972 developments.
accepted.sec: Hierarchy and leadership - Space Commission, DoS, ISRO, chairmen  [other exams]

accepted.s:

1. Vikram Sarabhai
2. P. Ramanathan
3. Commencement of work on TERLS in 1962

Select the correct answer.
accepted.x: INCOSPAR was associated with Vikram Sarabhai and Ramanathan, and work on TERLS began under it in 1962.

accepted.s:
With reference to the space-governance institutions, consider the following statements:
1. IN-SPACe was established in 2020 as an autonomous single-window regulator.
2. Its headquarters is at Ahmedabad.
3. NSIL was established in 2019 as a Central Public Sector Enterprise and commercial arm.
4. Antrix is the older commercial arm.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct: IN-SPACe was established in 2020 with headquarters at Ahmedabad, NSIL became the 2019 CPSE commercial arm, and Antrix is the older commercial arm.
accepted.tq: Test dates, headquarters and institutional roles together, while guarding against swapped commercial functions.

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

1. Vikram Sarabhai — Chairman of INCOSPAR
2. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam — Project Director of SLV-3
3. Satish Dhawan — SHAR named after him
4. U.R. Rao — URSC named after him

Select the correct answer.
accepted.x: All four pairs are correct. Sarabhai chaired INCOSPAR, Kalam directed the SLV-3 project, SHAR honours Satish Dhawan and URSC honours U.R. Rao.
accepted.tq: Match eminent scientists with their offices, projects and commemorative institutional names.
accepted.sec: Hierarchy and leadership - Space Commission, DoS, ISRO, chairmen  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Vikram Sarabhai is associated with which of the following?
1. Founding the Physical Research Laboratory
2. Conceiving Aryabhata and SITE
3. Founding IIM Ahmedabad, Darpana Academy and ATIRA
4. Serving as Chairman of the Atomic Energy Commission after Homi Bhabha

Select the correct answer.
accepted.x: All four statements are associated with Vikram Sarabhai. He also received the Padma Bhushan in 1966 and the Padma Vibhushan posthumously in 1972.
accepted.tq: Group multiple achievements under one personality and use the comprehensive option only when every item fits.
accepted.sec: Hierarchy and leadership - Space Commission, DoS, ISRO, chairmen  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched with Vikram Sarabhai?
o: First ISRO Chairman until his death in 1971
Founder of the Physical Research Laboratory
Father of the Indian space programme
Founder of the Indian Deep Space Network at Byalalu
accepted.x: Vikram Sarabhai was the father of the Indian space programme, first ISRO Chairman and founder of PRL. The Indian Deep Space Network is located at Byalalu, but it was not identified as his founding contribution.
accepted.tq: Reject an institution-location association that is not among the stated contributions of the personality.
accepted.sec: Hierarchy and leadership - Space Commission, DoS, ISRO, chairmen  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the sequence of ISRO Chairmen:
1. M.G.K. Menon preceded Satish Dhawan.
2. Satish Dhawan preceded U.R. Rao.
3. K. Kasturirangan preceded G. Madhavan Nair.
4. K. Sivan preceded A.S. Kiran Kumar.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: M.G.K. Menon preceded Satish Dhawan, Satish Dhawan preceded U.R. Rao, and K. Kasturirangan preceded G. Madhavan Nair. A.S. Kiran Kumar preceded K. Sivan, so statement 4 is false.
accepted.tq: Check relative order rather than memorising the list as an undifferentiated sequence.
accepted.sec: Hierarchy and leadership - Space Commission, DoS, ISRO, chairmen  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs of ISRO Chairmen and tenures is correctly matched?
accepted.x: U.R. Rao served as ISRO Chairman from 1984 to 1994. Kasturirangan served from 1994 to 2003, Madhavan Nair from 2003 to 2009 and Radhakrishnan from 2009 to 2014.
accepted.tq: Compare adjacent chairmanship periods and detect shifted tenure ranges.
accepted.sec: Hierarchy and leadership - Space Commission, DoS, ISRO, chairmen  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding K. Kasturirangan is correct?
o: He served as ISRO Chairman from 1984 to 1994 and died in 2015.
He served as ISRO Chairman from 2018 to 2022 and died in April 2025.
He served as ISRO Chairman from 1994 to 2003 and died in April 2025.
He served as ISRO Chairman from 2003 to 2009 and died in January 2025.
accepted.x: K. Kasturirangan was ISRO Chairman from 1994 to 2003 and died in April 2025.
accepted.tq: Combine the correct tenure with the biographical date to avoid adjacent-chairman confusion.
accepted.sec: Hierarchy and leadership - Space Commission, DoS, ISRO, chairmen  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about the chairmanship transition in January 2025 is correct?
o: A.S. Kiran Kumar succeeded S. Somanath as the 12th Space Secretary and ISRO Chairman.
S. Somanath succeeded K. Sivan as the 11th Space Secretary and ISRO Chairman.
V. Narayanan succeeded K. Kasturirangan as the 10th Space Secretary and ISRO Chairman.
V. Narayanan succeeded S. Somanath as the 11th Space Secretary and ISRO Chairman.
accepted.x: V. Narayanan became the 11th Space Secretary and ISRO Chairman in January 2025, succeeding S. Somanath.
accepted.tq: Use succession, ordinal number and date together to defeat swapped-leadership distractors.
accepted.sec: Hierarchy and leadership - Space Commission, DoS, ISRO, chairmen  [other exams]
